title: Magic Moments
lyrics_plain:
Magic moments
When two hearts are caring
Magic moments
Mem'ries we've been sharing
I'll never forget
the moment we kissed
that night at the hayride
The way that we hugged
and tried to keep warm
while taking a sleigh ride
Magic moments
When two hearts are caring
Magic moments
Mem'ries we've been sharing
Time can't erase
The mem'ry of
These magic moments
Filled with love
The telephone call
that tied up the line for hours and hours
The Saturday dance
I got up the nerve to send you some flowers
Magic moments
When two hearts are caring
Magic moments
Mem'ries we've been sharing
Time can't erase
The mem'ry of
These magic moments
Filled with love
(The way that we cheered whenever our team was scoring a touchdown)
The time when the floor fell out of my car when I put the clutch down
(The penny arcade the games that we played)
The fun and the prizes
(The halloween hop)
When everyone came in funny disguises
Magic moments filled with love
